episode.title: Holmes Went First, Not Last
episode.tagline: Ten sharp minds, one hidden enemy — five brutal days of accusations, betrayals, and votes decide who's left standing when the dust finally settles.
episode.recap: In the shadowed streets, RICO, SAGE, and DR. VANCE moved as one, unseen, unraveling the town from within — and it worked, at first, claiming Chen the Doctor before dawn's first accusation could even settle. But the town's blade found RICO on day two, cracking the mafia's unity wide open, even as the killers struck back mercilessly through the night, silencing Marshal the Detective and Ambassador Silva in cold succession. Dr. Vance fell next to the town's growing suspicion, leaving Sage alone to carry the mafia's dying cause. On the fifth and final day, the town cornered Sage and cast the last vote, extinguishing the conspiracy for good — Aria and Pip stood among the survivors as dawn broke on a town finally at peace.
